name: FairValid
tagline: Email verification and verified work-email discovery with an official MCP connector
description: FairValid helps sales and marketing teams verify single emails or CSV lists and find verified work emails with FairMatch. Original rows and columns stay attached to CSV exports. Valid or invalid verification results cost 1 credit; unknown and catch-all results have zero net credit cost. Each newly delivered FairMatch work email costs 4 credits. Start with 300 free credits each month. The official hosted MCP connector lets compatible AI assistants use email verification and FairMatch with scoped permissions and spending limits; API key or supported OAuth sign-in required.
